niche_preference_profile: Prefers light, neutral interfaces with soft purple accents, clear structure, and polished card-based containment. Favors concise content, explicit labels, and strong but integrated hierarchy over decorative, dark, oversized, or visually noisy treatments. Likes rounded components, subtle depth, and simplified data presentation with clear ordering and readable actions.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds and soft gray surfaces with restrained purple accents; rejects dark, high-contrast, electric, or heavily framed color treatments.
Prefers layouts with clear headings, labels, section spacing, alignment, and focal hierarchy so content is easy to scan and understand.
Prefers organized card grids, enclosed sections, and centered contained states rather than floating elements or weakly structured page layouts.
Prefers shorter text, simplified cards, and reduced decorative clutter with fewer competing elements and lower information density.
Prefers direct button labels, text-labeled actions, helper text, and clearly understandable controls over icon-only or verbose actions.
Prefers refined rounded cards, inputs, and containers with subtle borders or shadows that add softness and depth.

Prefers emphasis that supports the layout without dominating it, including compact integrated buttons, small contained icons, and softer loading indicators rather than oversized icons or overly aggressive CTAs.
